title: Mike Siegel Certified as District 7 Winner
meeting_type: Austin City Council Special Called Meeting
summary:
*   A special meeting officially confirmed the results of the December 14 runoff election.
*   Mike Siegel was declared the winner of the District 7 race, receiving a majority of votes (4,420 to 4,211).
*   This formal declaration officially makes Mike Siegel the new representative for District 7.
